test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

AB_N _DOP E_QR _HST IJU_
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• MCGIV → AB**M**N / **C**DOP / E**G**QR / **I**HST / IJU**V**
 
• CMGIV → AB**C**N / **M**DOP / EGQR / IHST / IJUV
 
• CMGFV → ABCN / MDOP / EGQR / **F**HST / IJU**V**
 
• MCFGV → ABMN / CDOP / E**F**QR / **G**HST / IJU**V**

When the sequence is divided into five equal parts, in option 4, we see that the first two letters and last two letters forms the alphabet series ABCDEFGHIJ - MNOPQRSTUV.

Hence, '**MCFGV**' is the correct answer.
